description.zh: 模型所在Collection，支持填写多个，用英文逗号分割
description.en: The collection where the model is located. You can specify multiple collections and separate them with commas (,).

description.zh: 配置领域来过滤该领域内的模型列表。例如：nlp（自然语言处理）、cv（计算机视觉）等。
description.en: The domain. Only models in the domain are returned. Valid values: nlp (Natural Language Processing) and cv (Computer Vision).

description.zh: 标签串。用于列表过滤，标签中key或value中，有指定字符串的，都会被过滤出来。
description.en: The label. Models whose label key or label value contains a specific label are filtered.

description.zh: 配置模型名称，用来过滤获取的模型列表。
description.en: The model name used to filter the returned models.

description.zh:
分页查询时，对指定的排序字段进行升序或降序。默认ASC。
- ASC：升序。
- DESC：降序。
description.en:
The order in which the entries are sorted by the specific field on the returned page. Default value: ASC.

*   ASC
*   DESC

description.zh: 配置模型源，来过滤属于该社区或组织的模型列表。例如ModelScope，HuggingFace等。
description.en: The model source used to filter the models that belong to a community or organization, such as ModelScope and Hugging Face.

description.zh: 模型列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的模型数量，默认为10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 提供者。指定提供者，则只返回该提供者公开的模型。不填则返回用户自己的模型。
description.en: The provider. If you configure this parameter, only the models exposed by the provider are returned. If you leave this parameter empty, only models owned by the user are returned.

description.zh:
配置查询条件。ModelName、Domain、Task、LabelKey、LabelValue相似匹配。
例如输入为nlp，则ModelName、Domain、Task、LabelKey、LabelValue中匹配的模型都会返回。
description.en: The query condition. For example, if you set the value to nlp, all models that match ModelName, Domain, Task, LabelKey, and LabelValue are returned.

description.zh: 分页查询时的排序字段。目前使用GmtCreateTime字段用于排序。
description.en: The field used to sort the results. The GmtCreateTime field is used for sorting.

description.zh: 配置任务来过滤属于该任务类型的模型列表。例如：text-classification（文本分类）等。
description.en: The task used to filter the models that belong to the task type. Example: text-classification.

description.zh: 配置工作空间ID，返回列表中只获取该工作空间内的模型列表。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见[ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
description.en: The workspace ID. Only models in this workspace are queried. You can call [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace list-models --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --order DESC --sort-by GmtCreateTime --workspace-id 32400 --model-name Sentiment_analysis --label key1 --provider pai --domain nlp --task text-classification --origin ModelScope --query nlp --model-type Endpoint --collections AI4D,QuickStart --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --conditions Operator=LessThan Column=ParameterSize Value=3000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun aiworkspace GET /api/v1/models --region cn-hangzhou --Order DESC --Origin ModelScope --Task 'text-classification' --ModelName Sentiment_analysis --PageSize 10 --Query nlp --SortBy GmtCreateTime --WorkspaceId 32400 --Label key1 --Conditions '[{"Operator":"LessThan","Column":"ParameterSize","Value":"3000"}]' --Provider pai --PageNumber 1 --ModelType Endpoint --Tag '[{"Value":"value1","Key":"key1"}]' --Domain nlp --Collections 'AI4D,QuickStart' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
